items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...don’t forget that, he was a baby when he joined the band I understand, from Boston — I can’t think of his name. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Harry Carney.

ctx.x: Oh, Hodges, of course, you know and the baritone player, don’t forget that, he was a baby when he joined the band I understand, from Boston — I can’t think of his name.
Harry Carney, yeah. And Ben Webster when he got in there. My first record, the first record I bought was “KoKo.” And the second was “Truckin.’” And then “Cottontail.”
